name: KiCad KRT Gloss
description: Apply the KRT-based final track gloss to selected or all routed nets.
description_full:
Shorten and simplify routed nets through the KiCad IPC API, using KRT for clearance and connectivity validation. Supports remembered branches without highlighting. Optional before-and-after drawings use a free enabled User layer. Requires recent KiCad 10.99/11 rule-reading commands. Developed by Frantz with assistance from ChatGPT/Codex (OpenAI).

Based on KiCad Routing Tools (KRT) by DrAndyHaas
https://github.com/drandyhaas/KiCadRoutingTools
